SELECT t1.code_module, AVG(t2.score) FROM studentInfo AS t1 JOIN assessments AS t3 ON t1.code_module = t3.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t3.code_presentation JOIN studentAssessment AS t2 ON t3.id_assessment = t2.id_assessment AND t1.id_student = t2.id_student WHERE (t1.final_result = 'Pass' OR t1.final_result = 'Distinction') AND t3.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY t1.code_module
